policy.en: Use these as planning suggestions, not proof of suitability, completed customer orders, certifications or performance. Confirm the selected configuration, intended use and model instructions.
policy.zh: 这些为选型建议，不是适用性测试、已完成客户订单、认证或性能证明。需核对所选配置、用途和型号说明。

brief.en: Plan cups and bar accessories by drink, service point and cleaning routine. Model references guide selection; the final configuration and use instructions must be agreed.
brief.zh: 按饮品、服务点与清洁方式选杯具和酒具配件。型号用于选型参考，具体配置与使用说明需逐项确认。

brief.en: Select vessels and serving tools for adult beverage tastings. Confirm serving portions, venue rules and the selected model before approving artwork.
brief.zh: 为成人饮品品鉴活动选择杯型与服务工具，先核对单次份量、场地规定和所选型号，再审核图稿。

brief.en: Review cups for nonalcoholic family-event service. A family use suggestion does not establish a tested age range, child-safety certification or heat rating.
brief.zh: 为家庭活动的非酒精饮品服务选杯。场景建议不代表已验证的适用年龄、儿童安全认证或耐热等级。

brief.en: Coordinate the selected item with the artwork, kit contents and packing plan.
brief.zh: 将所选产品与图稿、套装组成和包装方案一起核对。

brief.en: Review carrying space, configuration and the intended drink before choosing the model.
brief.zh: 按携带空间、具体配置和饮品用途核对型号。

brief.en: Review venue rules, beverage service and carrying requirements.
brief.zh: 核对场地规定、饮品服务方式与携带要求。

brief.en: Plan personal cups separately from shared service tools and accessories.
brief.zh: 分别规划个人杯具、共用服务工具与配件。

brief.en: Review the beverage format, guest service and packing plan.
brief.zh: 核对饮品形式、宾客服务方式与包装方案。

brief.en: Review the lighting plan, activation and venue conditions for the selected reference.
brief.zh: 按所选型号核对灯光方案、触发方式和场地条件。

brief.en: Match seasonal artwork and packing to the actual selected model.
brief.zh: 将节庆图稿与包装匹配到实际选择的型号。

brief.en: Check venue rules and serving needs for the event.
brief.zh: 核对活动场地规定与饮品服务需求。
